profile.headline: Lead Full Stack / Product Engineer | LAMP (PHP, Laravel), Node.js, Vue, React, Angular, Python (Flask), GraphQL | DevOps, API Architecture & UX-Driven Development
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack / product engineer experienced in building secure, high-performance applications using React, Angular, Vue 3, Laravel, CodeIgniter 4, Flask, and WordPress. Over the past several years, I’ve delivered end-to-end solutions across JavaScript (Node.js, Express, GraphQL) and Python/PHP ecosystems, managing everything from UI/UX design to scalable API architecture and database optimization.

My work spans enterprise dashboards, CMS integrations, data-driven applications, and SaaS platforms, with a focus on clean architecture, responsive design, and efficient DevOps workflows.

Fluent across the MERN and MEAN stacks, I combine technical precision with strategic problem-solving — ensuring each product is fast, maintainable, and aligned with business goals.

Configured security headers and performed security and performance audits.

positions.title: University Recruiting Associate - Tier 1 Support (AMR Help Desk)
positions.description:
• Own the recruiting process from the point of an offer being accepted to the start date.
• Consult with internal stakeholders to identify business needs and recommended solutions.
• Work in recruiting systems and cross-functionally with Recruiters/Hiring Managers/Admins to create positions and requisitions (HRIS and ATS).
• Respond to teammate inquiries, questions and complaints, and provide information, guidance and direction on core HR Operations functions.
• Create and support the effective integration of HR processes, programs, and practices into daily operations.
• Support change management related to the implementation of organizational effectiveness solutions.
• Work with the staffing teams’ sourcing strategy as defined and directed by the Staffing Manager.
• Partner with assigned Staffing Consultant(s) to support open requirements for the client groups.
• Collect & ensure pertinent updates and weekly audits are provided to team members and/or University Recruiting partners in an accurate and timely fashion.
• Managing a high-volume email inbox with over 100-200 inquiries per day. Prioritize which mails are most important and build tactics and templates to maintain 2-day response SLA.

positions.title: University Recruiting Associate - Req Help
positions.description:
▪ Driving projects and deadlines by organizing deliverables and delegating tasks to stakeholders and partners.
▪ Manage high volume inbox to scale 10,000+ requisitions for current and future inventory.
▪ Perform in-depth root cause analysis of system processes to identify issues and develop plans of action.
▪ Coordinate with global stakeholders to maintain data accuracy and initiate process improvements
• Created and maintained hiring positions for thousands of roles within various Microsoft divisions.
• Coordinated with hiring managers to reconcile positions with budgetary constraints.
• Organized position inventory for future hiring events to support internal and external stakeholders.
• Developed process improvements and wrote SOPs to define procedures for future team members to streamline onboarding and training.

positions.title: Logistics Specialist
positions.description:
Demonstrated superior organizational skills, troubleshooting, and ability to forecast and anticipate needs—prioritizing to support business continuity, minimize costs, maximize efficiency, and ensure readiness in inventory supply. 

▪ Leveraged diplomatic communication skills, relationship building, and logical decision making to support a customer-focused organizational culture. 

▪ Processed orders on SAP Business One and FedEx Ship manager. 

▪ Made positive contributions during a period of business turbulence (shutdown of sterile production). Paired efforts with other department leaders and teams.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: Cultivated customer relationships in the healthcare industry via multiple platforms while accurately executing orders through SAP software. Diplomatically resolve customer complaints and concerns. Collaborated across departments to create the optimal solution.
